authorization: User approved three-arm small-scale policy RL after real update/save/resume acceptance; no 6M expansion or D adaptation
initialization: same original Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B base and freshly matched LoRA16; never continue historical A/B policies
A: original TRL group-standardized repaired binary outcome reward
C_mix: original TRL group-standardized y+0.2*min(C step probabilities)
C_bounded: (y-mean(y))/(sample_std(y)+1e-4)+0.2*y*(m-mean(m among correct)); no normalization after combination
PRM_precision: C scorer disables TF32 only locally and restores caller precision
evaluation: all 500 existing held-out original-MATH validation questions, greedy, unchanged original prompt and repaired verifier, cap2048; initial base and each final policy; no MATH500/GSM8K test-based tuning
stopping: first completed optimizer update at/above 1M; incomplete/failing job blocks controller, no automatic restart; all arms follow same smoke/resume schedule
interpretation: pilot is exploratory seed17; paired intervals and pathology measures; no automatic 6M promotion or declaration of statistical equivalence
resume_limitation: optimizer/adapter/scheduler/RNG/dataset skip verified; pinned colocated vLLM sampling RNG is recreated on process restart, so no claim of bitwise equivalence to an uninterrupted run
